FN-6YJEKZ3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 32
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 32 as introduced could decrease receipts to certain counties and municipalities by an
undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, dependent upon the amount of solid
waste collection fees not collected from certain households whose sole income is veterans'
benefits, as provided by this bill.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 32
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/16/2026
Senate Bill 32 as passed the Senate could decrease receipts to certain counties and
municipalities by an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, dependent upon the
amount of solid waste collection fees not collected from certain households whose sole income
is veterans' benefits, as provided by this bill.

FN-6YJEKZ3-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 32
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/18/2026
Senate Bill 32 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government could
decrease receipts to certain counties and municipalities that choose to adopt an exemption as
provided in this bill, by an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2028, dependent
upon the amount of solid waste collection fees not collected from certain households whose sole
income is veterans' benefits, as provided by this bill.
